summary_zh: 小男孩乌西受祖母之托，送鸡蛋去给父母制作姐姐婚礼的大蛋糕。路上他遭遇了一连串意外：顽皮小男孩砸碎了鸡蛋，用弹弓补偿；修剪树枝的工人们弄断了弹弓，用木柴补偿；烘焙面包的师傅们把木柴烧掉，用新鲜面包补偿；牧牛人饥饿抢食了面包，用拐杖补偿。最后乌西不慎把拐杖掉进草丛摔成两截，失落赶到婚礼现场。然而深爱弟弟的姐姐温柔开导他，告诉他最珍贵的礼物是弟弟平安盛装出席，两人共同在喜悦中起舞。

sentences.text: Early one morning Vusi’s granny called him, “Vusi, please take this egg to your parents.
sentences.translation_zh: 清晨的一大早，乌西的奶奶叫他：“乌西，请把这个鸡蛋带给你父母。

sentences.text: They want to make a large cake for your sister’s wedding.”
sentences.translation_zh: 他们想为你姐姐的婚礼做一个大蛋糕。”

sentences.text: On his way to his parents, Vusi met two boys picking fruit.
sentences.translation_zh: 在去父母家的路上，乌西遇到了两个正在摘水果的小男孩。

phrases.surface: On his way to his parents

sentences.text: One boy grabbed the egg from Vusi and shot it at a tree.
sentences.translation_zh: 一个男孩抢过乌西手里的鸡蛋，一把扔向了一棵大树。

sentences.text: The egg broke.
sentences.translation_zh: 鸡蛋碎了。

sentences.text: “What have you done?” cried Vusi.
sentences.translation_zh: “你们都干了些什么呀！”乌西大哭起来。

sentences.text: “That egg was for a cake.
sentences.translation_zh: “那个鸡蛋是用来做蛋糕的。

sentences.text: The cake was for my sister’s wedding.
sentences.translation_zh: 蛋糕是给我姐姐婚礼准备的。

sentences.text: What will my sister say if there is no wedding cake?”
sentences.translation_zh: 要是没有婚礼蛋糕，我姐姐会怎么说呢？”

sentences.text: The boys were sorry for teasing Vusi.
sentences.translation_zh: 男孩们为戏弄乌西感到很抱歉。

sentences.text: “We can’t help with the cake, but here is a walking stick for your sister,” said one.
sentences.translation_zh: “蛋糕的事我们帮不上忙，不过这根送给你姐姐的拐杖你拿着吧，”其中一个男孩说。

sentences.text: Vusi continued on his journey.
sentences.translation_zh: 乌西继续往前赶路。

sentences.text: Along the way he met two men building a house.
sentences.translation_zh: 一路上，他遇到两个正在盖房子的男人。

sentences.text: “Can we use that strong stick?” asked one.
sentences.translation_zh: “我们能用一下那根结实的木棍吗？”其中一个人问。

sentences.text: But the stick was not strong enough for building, and it broke.
sentences.translation_zh: 但是那根木棍对建筑来说不够结实，结果断掉了。

sentences.text: “What have you done?” cried Vusi.
sentences.translation_zh: “你们都干了些什么呀！”乌西大哭起来。

sentences.text: “That stick was a gift for my sister.
sentences.translation_zh: “那根木棍是给我姐姐的礼物。

sentences.text: The fruit pickers gave me the stick because they broke the egg for the cake.
sentences.translation_zh: 摘水果的男孩们给我木棍，是因为他们打碎了做蛋糕的鸡蛋。

sentences.text: The cake was for my sister’s wedding.
sentences.translation_zh: 蛋糕是给我姐姐婚礼准备的。

sentences.text: Now there is no egg, no cake, and no gift.
sentences.translation_zh: 现在没有鸡蛋，没有蛋糕，也没有礼物了。

sentences.text: What will my sister say?”
sentences.translation_zh: 我姐姐会怎么说呢？”

sentences.text: The builders were sorry for breaking the stick.
sentences.translation_zh: 建筑工人们为弄断了木棍感到抱歉。

sentences.text: “We can’t help with the cake, but here is some thatch for your sister,” said one.
sentences.translation_zh: “蛋糕的事我们帮不上忙，不过这有些给你姐姐盖屋顶用的茅草，你拿去吧，”其中一人说。

sentences.text: And so Vusi continued on his journey.
sentences.translation_zh: 于是，乌西继续往前走。

sentences.text: Along the way, Vusi met a farmer and a cow.
sentences.translation_zh: 沿路上，乌西遇见了一位农夫和一头奶牛。

sentences.text: “What delicious thatch, can I have a nibble?” asked the cow.
sentences.translation_zh: “多么美味的茅草呀，我能啃一口吗？”奶牛问。

sentences.text: But the thatch was so tasty that the cow ate it all!
sentences.translation_zh: 可是茅草实在太好吃了，奶牛把它全吃光了。

sentences.text: “What have you done?” cried Vusi.
sentences.translation_zh: “你都干了些什么呀！”乌西大哭起来。

sentences.text: “That thatch was a gift for my sister.
sentences.translation_zh: “那些茅草是给我姐姐的礼物。

sentences.text: The builders gave me the thatch because they broke the stick from the fruit pickers.
sentences.translation_zh: 建筑工人给我茅草，是因为他们弄断了摘水果男孩给我的木棍。

sentences.text: The fruit pickers gave me the stick because they broke the egg for my sister’s cake.
sentences.translation_zh: 摘水果的男孩给我木棍，是因为他们打碎了给姐姐的蛋糕用的鸡蛋。

sentences.text: The cake was for my sister’s wedding.
sentences.translation_zh: 蛋糕是给我姐姐婚礼准备的。

sentences.text: Now there is no egg, no cake, and no gift.
sentences.translation_zh: 现在没有鸡蛋，没有蛋糕，也没有礼物了。

sentences.text: What will my sister say?”
sentences.translation_zh: 我姐姐会怎么说呢？”

sentences.text: The cow was sorry she was greedy.
sentences.translation_zh: 奶牛为自己的贪吃感到很内疚。

sentences.text: The farmer agreed that the cow could go with Vusi as a gift for his sister.
sentences.translation_zh: 农夫同意让这头奶牛跟乌西走，作为送给他姐姐的礼物。

sentences.text: And so Vusi carried on.
sentences.translation_zh: 于是乌西继续往前走。

sentences.text: But the cow ran back to the farmer at supper time.
sentences.translation_zh: 但是一到吃晚饭的时间，奶牛就跑回农夫那里去了。

sentences.text: And Vusi got lost on his journey.
sentences.translation_zh: 乌西在路上迷了路。

sentences.text: He arrived very late for his sister’s wedding.
sentences.translation_zh: 他赶到姐姐的婚礼时已经非常迟了。

sentences.text: The guests were already eating.
sentences.translation_zh: 宾客们已经在吃酒席了。

sentences.text: “What shall I do?” cried Vusi.
sentences.translation_zh: “我该怎么办呀！”乌西大哭起来。

sentences.text: “The cow that ran away was a gift, in return for the thatch the builders gave me.
sentences.translation_zh: “那头跑掉的奶牛是建筑工人给我茅草的补偿物。

sentences.text: The builders gave me the thatch because they broke the stick from the fruit pickers.
sentences.translation_zh: 建筑工人给我茅草，是因为他们弄断了摘水果男孩给我的木棍。

sentences.text: It all started with the egg for the wedding cake.
sentences.translation_zh: 这一切全都始于做婚礼蛋糕的那个鸡蛋。

sentences.text: Now there is no egg, no cake, and no gift.”
sentences.translation_zh: 现在没有鸡蛋，没有蛋糕，也没有礼物了。”

sentences.text: Vusi’s sister thought for a while, then she said, “Vusi my brother, I don’t really care about gifts.
sentences.translation_zh: 乌西的姐姐想了一会儿，然后她说：“乌西，我的好弟弟，我真的不在乎什么礼物。

sentences.text: I don’t even care about the cake!
sentences.translation_zh: 我甚至连蛋糕都不在乎。

sentences.text: We are all here together, I am happy.
sentences.translation_zh: 我们大家都在这里聚在一起，我就感到很幸福了。

sentences.text: Now put on your smart clothes and let’s celebrate this day!”
sentences.translation_zh: 现在穿上你的漂亮衣服，咱们一起庆祝这一天吧！”

sentences.text: And so that’s what Vusi did.
sentences.translation_zh: 于是乌西就那样做了。

rights.author: Nina Orange
rights.modifications: 严格依照原版故事因果链改编为B1阅读材料，讲述小男孩在姐姐婚礼前经历接连意外物品交换最终感悟亲情真谛的经典民间故事，提供逐句中文翻译与逐词语境释义。
